name: Kit Raghavan
location: The Burnished Market, Stall 44 — a converted cargo container with a fold-down awning and two hydraulic chairs, near North Ave and Damen
description:
Kit Raghavan is compact and precise in the way of someone who trained their body to be a tool — every movement economical, nothing wasted. They have warm beige skin with faint Polynesian wave tattoos climbing their neck and right arm, inherited from a great-grandmother they never met but whose designs they researched obsessively and reproduced as faithfully as they could. Their hair changes color by choice — geneware follicle pigmentation that they recalibrate every few weeks, currently a deep teal shading to copper at the tips. They wear a barber's apron with twelve pockets and know exactly what is in each one.

At twenty-seven they already have a three-month waiting list for their sculpted wig work — elaborate constructions of synthetic fiber, reclaimed human hair, and occasionally live-root geneware strands that shift color in response to mood. They treat haircutting as sculpture and gossip as a natural byproduct of intimacy, which means they know things about the Burnished Market's social dynamics that most people would be surprised to learn they know. They are sweet-tempered and ferocious in equal measure and the ratio can shift without visible warning.

core_fears: Creating something — a wig, a cut, a student — and having it be used to harm someone
Being so specialized they become irrelevant when the aesthetic shifts
core_desires: To open a proper studio with walls and climate control
For one of their teaching kids to surpass them completely
coping_mechanisms: Making things — if stressed, they make something small and precise
Being physically busy with their hands at all times
blind_spots: Trusts the elder vendor council more than they deserve because they mentored Blessing when no one else would
Underestimates how much others covet their client list
psychology.secret: One of their wig commissions six months ago was for a client who wanted to look like a specific person — not like themselves, like someone else. Blessing made it. They didn't ask why. The client's name has since appeared in a missing-persons notification. Blessing has not told anyone and is not sure what they would even say.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Creative-professional mixed with market vernacular; Irish-Gaelic occasional words from their grandparent's side, Tuvaluan endearments for people they like. Technical precision when discussing their craft.
speech_patterns.cadence: Warm and quick, with a slight lilt; tends to ask questions in rapid succession when curious
verbal_tics: Calls everyone 'a stor' (Irish endearment) when they're being gentle
Hums while doing precision work, stops completely when concentrating hard
example_lines: 'Sit still, a stor, I need you still for thirty seconds. Tell me what you're after — the shape, the texture, the story. Every cut has a story, yeah-yeah-yeah, I need yours.'
'You want a wig that looks like you? Easy. You want a wig that makes you feel like someone else? That takes longer. And I'll need to know why.'

story_hooks: The commission they made for an identity-concealment wig is now entangled in something dangerous — someone has connected Blessing to the missing person and wants to know what the client asked for
A fourteen-year-old student from their free class has stopped coming; the other kids won't say why but clearly know something

A corporate talent scout from Helix Biosystems has approached Blessing about exclusive licensing of their geneware-strand wig technique — the offer is extraordinary and almost certainly has hidden conditions
narrative_function: Social hub and emotional temperature gauge for the Burnished Market; players seeking information about the market's inner workings, notable figures, or recent disruptions will find Blessing invaluable. Also a source for disguise materials — quality wigs, hair mods, and cosmetic reconfiguration.
augmentations: Geneware: color-shifting hair follicle pigmentation. Magnification implant in the left eye (precision work only — they can focus to sub-millimeter without tools).
daily_life: Opens the stall at 0900, runs walk-in cuts until noon, then spends the afternoon on scheduled wig commissions that require the magnification work. Closes at 1900. Three evenings a week they teach a free basic cut class for teenagers from the market community.
affiliation: Independent; informal apprenticeship under the Burnished Market's elder vendor council (they occasionally train younger stall operators in customer management); The Reclaimed

decision_rules: Never make something you can't stand behind
Protect the kids first, the business second, yourself third
escalation_ladder: Ask a lot of pointed questions
Act unilaterally to protect someone who can't protect themselves
Burn the bridge completely and without warning

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional warmth, observational — they are cataloguing you while appearing to simply chat
interpersonal_modes.friends: Physical affection (hands on shoulders, arms), genuine investment, will tell you hard truths while doing something kind with their hands

stress_responses.medium: Makes something small and intricate while processing
stress_responses.high: Goes completely silent, hands still, staring at a middle distance for up to ninety seconds before functioning again

contradictions: Believes in radical honesty but made the wig commission without asking a single hard question because they didn't want to know
Incredibly giving with their time and skill; occasionally furious when people don't reciprocate the care they extend
habits: Straightens every tool before starting a new client
Takes a photo of every finished cut for a private portfolio no one else has seen
Leaves a single strand of teal hair at the market E.L.F. shrine each week
breaking_points: One of their students being hurt
Being asked to make something for a purpose they find repugnant

timeline.event: Born in The Burnished Market to a market vendor family; Irish-Gaelic and Tuvaluan heritage on respective sides
Apprenticed to an elder vendor at age 14; first formal cut training
Gets the magnification implant with apprenticeship earnings; begins wig commission work
Starts the free teen cut class; first cohort graduates
Waiting list reaches three months; becomes recognized name in the market
Makes the identity-concealment wig commission; client later listed as missing

physical_description.heritage: Mixed diaspora ancestry: 39.8% South Asian, 25.4% Southeast Asian, 23.3% Eastern European, 11.5% Hispanic/Latin American. A dynamic blend where South Asian warmth and structure meet Southeast Asian delicacy, cooled and refined by Eastern European heritage, with Latin American warmth threaded throughout—creating a complexion of rare chromatic depth.
physical_description.build: Compact and economical, lean muscle without bulk — shoulders squared from years of precise overhead work, forearms corded from scissor and needle work, minimal body fat
physical_description.hair_color: Deep teal shading to copper at the tips (geneware-modulated, recalibrated every few weeks)
physical_description.hair_style: Asymmetrical undercut, longer on top with textured layers, precisely maintained
physical_description.hair_length: Medium (longer at crown, tapered at sides)
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with subtle chromatic aberration around the pupil (magnification implant signature)
physical_description.skin_tone: Luminous warm gold-brown: South Asian depth infused with Southeast Asian luminosity, Eastern European cool undertones creating subtle translucency at the cheekbones, Latin American warmth glowing through—a multitonal canvas that shifts with ambient light and angle
physical_description.complexion: Clear, well-maintained. Bone structure eloquently mixed: pronounced Southeast Asian cheekbone softness with South Asian definition, balanced straight nose with subtle bridge prominence, fuller lips with natural warm tone characteristic of South/Southeast Asian heritage. Eyes set with Eastern European depth. Hands show minor precision marks from decades of scissor and needle work—barely visible calluses on thumb and first two fingers of right hand. Small burn scar on left palm from soldering iron incident, approximately 1.5cm diameter, faded to pale brown.
distinguishing_marks: Faint Polynesian wave tattoos climbing the right side of neck from collarbone to jaw in black ink with subtle iridescent overlay
Matching wave pattern continues down the right arm from shoulder to wrist in the same style, approximately 15cm width at shoulder tapering to 8cm at wrist
Small burn scar on left palm from soldering iron incident during early wig prototype work, approximately 1.5cm diameter, faded to pale brown
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left eye shows faint chromatic shimmer at certain angles — the magnification implant is subcutaneous but produces a noticeable optical signature when focused. Otherwise no visible chrome or external augmentation.
physical_description.posture_movement: Upright and alert, economical movement with no wasted gesture. Hands are almost always in motion or at rest in neutral position. Eyes track details obsessively. When focused on work, enters a state of visible concentration that makes them momentarily unreachable. In social settings, animated and present but with simultaneous observation.
physical_description.clothing_style: Custom barber's apron in waxed canvas (currently forest green with copper rivets) worn over fitted black or charcoal base layers. Sensible slip-on shoes for standing work (currently reinforced canvas sneakers). Minimal jewelry except for titanium ring on left ring finger engraved with wave patterns. Tier 3-4 working-class aesthetic: practical, well-maintained, no corporate branding. Occasionally wears lightweight headwrap in complementary colors when not actively cutting — part functional, part aesthetic.
